claim: The scope proposal requires the model to supply the set date, which the model has no way of knowing.
A short research span that the page does carry is treated as a misquote: the verdict note falsely says the page does not carry it, and the span is withheld from the verifier.
A numbered list that restarts at "1." after a blank line is merged into the preceding list and renumbered; the wrap and continuation paths have no direct tests.

file: src/web (company switcher, home list, conversation view)
claim: [Round two, fbdd9d2] Company names in the switcher and home list, and a conversation's insight origin, render without the record marking, so the guard flags or misses them.
A message the server never received appears as sent, and the failure reads as Ed not answering.
The setup page shows the old research plan and a Start research control that the server refuses, rather than Ed's draft plan awaiting confirmation.
Setup work runs outside the error handler, so a failure there can leave notes stuck in 'sent' status.
A moved question or a claim verdict reaches the batch's model call without checking the company's provider permission.
A premise flag is closed when its run starts, so a run that later fails disappears from view with the flag still closed.
An Action's revision reason and author are shown to a client, outside the ruling that a client reads only notes they wrote.
The new Documents place shows a client internal (strategist-side) documents and research-pack sources that should not be listed to a client.
The web server does not drain briefings in flight before shutting down.
A Deep question asked of 'Your documents' runs web research instead of staying within the company's documents.
The chat page script throws on Ed's own standing chat, which has no composer, and the exception also stops the artefact panel's script from running.
A document claimed for reading stays stuck permanently if the job dies mid-read, because a stale read claim is never released or retaken.
The settle function (confirming existing document drafts) has no caller, so it never runs.
Side reads of the Bounties set (an answer's check, a briefing, Ed's pass, the Next round route) open a new round as a side effect of reading.
A failure to read or write the bounty round breaks every page that shows Bounties, with no fallback.
Bounties History shows a client the note attached to any move on a question as if it were the answer, exposing strategist notes to the client.

The step that retires an earlier attempt's insights also supersedes scored, merged and shown (client-visible) insights. It leaves no record of why they were retired, so their reasons are lost, and their dependents (Actions, notes) are orphaned.

retireIfShown (src/pipeline/recompute.ts) marks a hidden original (rejected, unresolved or quarantined) as superseded once its rerun is shown. That makes it match clientInsightSql's standing-in rule (superseded, with nothing later released), so a client can see an insight the strategist rejected while its rerun waits for release. Raised at 8862f85 and again at f367eb4.

In the scoring retry's check-before-render path, a verification that was truncated (did not complete) is treated as passed or checked, so insights are rendered as verified when they were not fully checked.

line: archive company path / scheduled cycle firing (file not stated; likely src/web/server.ts archive route and src/ops/queue.ts)
claim: Archiving a company leaves its registered cron in place, and nothing checks the archive, so scheduled research cycles keep firing for an archived company.

The plan's questions for the person (what only the company can answer) are stored with origin plan_derivation. As a result the Bounty paths ignore them, research spawns them as research questions, and the next config save switches them off.
The insights-writing time history used for estimates counts edits and recomputes along with insights written in a research cycle, so the 'time left' estimate is built from unlike work.
When the read of a run's topics fails, the notice falls back to a false 'Did not start' message, and the failure is neither logged nor said.
At 481e16b: a failed brand read (site fetch or parse) overwrites the company's stored brand with empty values, wiping the brand that was kept before.
Migration 123 does not correctly carry the brand columns the code relies on, so a database other than the one aligned by hand lacks them.
Ed's Research actions are not correctly scoped to the current subject (company), so an action can run with the wrong subject scope.
